wyg_intro: A living, interactive itinerary built entirely around how you actually travel. You fill in the questionnaire — I read it, think about your travel style, and build something that genuinely fits.
wyg_card_1_desc: Every activity, every meal, every stop is chosen for your specific trip — your budget, your group, your pace, your interests. Nothing generic, nothing assumed.
wyg_card_2_desc: Access your itinerary anytime, on any device. Interactive day-by-day breakdowns. Not a PDF you download and lose.
wyg_card_3_desc: Questions come up during the trip. Message me directly through the platform — get a real answer within your plan's timeframe, on business days.
qcta_sub: Fill in the questionnaire — it takes about 5 minutes and becomes the foundation of everything I build for you.
faq_q1: How long does it take to receive my itinerary?
faq_a1: After you submit your questionnaire, I'll review it personally to confirm it's a good fit. Once you've signed the service agreement and payment is received, I'll send you a confirmation email and I get started. You'll get a notification the moment your itinerary is live on the platform — expect it within 7–10 business days.
faq_q2: What if I want to change my itinerary after I receive it?
faq_a2: That's exactly what revision rounds are for. Every itinerary includes revision rounds based on your plan (1 for Escape, 2 for Discover, 3 for Immerse) — if your dates shift, your group changes, or you want to add or remove activities, just message me through the platform.
faq_q3: How do I choose the right plan?
faq_a3: Plans are based on trip length and complexity: Escape covers 1–3 days in one city, Discover covers 4–7 days, Immerse covers 8–14 days or multiple cities. Not sure which fits? Start the questionnaire and I'll confirm the right plan with you before anything is finalized.
faq_q4: What's the difference between a single trip and the Bundle?
faq_a4: A single trip plan (Escape, Discover, or Immerse) covers just your itinerary. The Bundle combines a Travel itinerary with a Relocation guide at a discount — built for people who are moving and want to explore their new home too. Relocation tiers within a Bundle stay flexible and get confirmed after your questionnaire.
faq_a5: All Travel plans get replies within 72 hours, on business days. Offline support runs 30 days (Escape), 45 days (Discover), or 60 days (Immerse) after delivery. Bundle support follows the combined plan confirmed with you after questionnaire review.
faq_a6: If you request a refund before I start work on your itinerary, you'll get a full refund. Once work begins, refunds are not available — but I'll always apply revision rounds if something isn't right. Not sure? Try the free Explorer sample first.
